Two comments

X: 2 & X:3 ~ “The Concert Hornpipe”

X: 2 ~ With corrections to dafydd’s original transcription. It’s in Bb Major, but since we haven’t that in the drop down menu I’ve chosen the relative key of C Dorian in order to get the two flats needed for the key signature…

X: 3 ~ dafydd’s transcription transposed to D Major…

↳ Posted by ceolachan on April 12th, 2013.

X: 4 & X: 5 ~ “The Concert Hornpipe” ~ Kerr’s twice over

B: “Kerr’s Second Collection of Merry Melodies”, 1880s, page 43, tune #384

↳ Posted by ceolachan on April 12th, 2013.
